hypothesis: Problem-first hooks get more sign-ups than product-first hooks

rules.scale: problem-first ahead on sign-ups per 1,000 views with >= 20 sign-ups total
rules.inconclusive: fewer than 20 sign-ups total at decision date

result: problem-first 9 sign-ups on 4,000 views (2.25 per 1,000); product-first 2 sign-ups on 3,800 views (0.53 per 1,000); 11 sign-ups total
lesson: Problem-first led 2.25 to 0.53 per 1,000 views on 11 sign-ups, under the 20 the rule needs; directional only.
